title: All-or-Nothing
subtitle: The good news is, 10 more moves to go.

trails.title: Trail ① The Hardest Mode
trails.description: Don't waste such a chance. Hardest mode it is.

content.text: I just woke up. What happened?

branch.text: That was a good sleep, dude. You drooled everywhere. Almost glued my eyelids.

You didn’t expect there to be so many complicated, confusing factions in the Foundation—can’t they just make this institution simpler so that people can tell one group from another easily, like telling the difference between cake layers?

content.text: I have no trouble. Don't come over.

branch.text: Really? Dude, are you 100% sure that you are trouble-free?
I was sleeping like a baby, having a sweet sweet dream which has been long absent in my life. There were three ladies, a bevy of goofy swans, and I, living a harmonious life together in my dream.

Suddenly, a certain jinx woke me up, saying, “I have no trouble. Don’t come over.” How wonderful! I was like a stray dog sleeping on a square. You’ll see, this old man is going to shovel all his complaints into your pure, innocent ear.
How do you feel about the structure of the Foundation? I can see your cockily raised neck, showing your attitude of rejection. Well, perfect! Let’s start with this intriguing topic, then!

content.text: The Foundation is a mess. Listen up, it drifts along the chaotic swirl between order and disorder, enticing countless idealists and realists to come over.
The “Storm” exacerbates the chaos. Those arcanists who were snorkeling are now surfacing—You see, Ms. Z is a great example. She is even sitting at the same conference table with the human elites.

The undercurrents, however, are still lurking. Natural Resource Committee, Mankind Caucus, Culture and Education Department ... Their members are hard to differentiate given the intricate backgrounds. They bustled for benefits and mired in countless trivial matters.

You see? You need to divide them into groups, and divide and divide ... until you break a huge entity into small groups, as small as possible. That’s when they are able to clean the vomit on the living room floor effectively and emotionlessly!

items.text: All-or-Nothing

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: We are falling behind even further. A vote or two won't help us turn this around ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I know.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The move to D9 was indeed useless.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: The arcanists that were on our side have defected.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: I misjudged the situation in the debate ...

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: I was going to seize the opportunity ... and the initiative ...
She doesn't respond to him, only pacing back and forth in the room.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: To seize the initiative ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: ... may bring us the chance.
Thirty-eight lines go across the board in horizontal and vertical directions, crossing one another in 361 intersections as orderly as the stars.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: That is to say, don't pull back, don't jump ... even when they're attacking ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: But to focus on the bigger picture, to win strong positions ...
She seems to have a sudden flash of insights, and reaches out one of her hands without being aware of doing so.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The Black ... tsuke.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Then ... the White hane. And the Black counter hane here. The White stand, the Black ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Osae.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Through these moves ... I see.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The move to D11 can save us more than ten moku of stones.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: We can still win within ten moves.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Mark.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: Yes? Are there any other things we can do?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: We need an influencer. A leader who can win us more than ten votes.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Get me the files of the uncommitted leaders, including those who weren't neutral about this issue in the beginning.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: ... Okay.
He seems perplexed, but still quickly retrieves the files and starts browsing them on the chair.
The room is in complete silence except for the slight noise of flipping pages.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: Barzel.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: No. Too young to be convincing.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: Nonie, head of the Natural Resource Committee.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: There are only three of them in the group.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: "Center" Bernard, leader of the Mankind Caucus ... Ugh, forget it.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Bernard?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yes, he can be our man. He is eloquent and leads a group of 11. All of the 11 are his loyal followers.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Why is he uncommitted? I thought he would be the first to vote.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: Perhaps they believe it's a sure bet ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Find out what he's been up to.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: But Madam Z, are you sure you want to cooperate with him? This doesn't make any sense. We don't even serve the same group.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Mark, we are all serving for the Foundation's future.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I just want to know what he needs now.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: The office in Chicago, U.S.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: He is trying to cover that region with his influence.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: Bernard believes the employees there are guilty of serious dereliction of duty: they discriminate against humans of different classes and are suspected of committing electoral fraud in collusion with the local capitals.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: The Supreme Court's investigators have already intervened.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: But they cannot go out due to the "Storm" right now ... so the case is pending investigation.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Chicago office ... I've read the reports on there ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Great. Exactly what we can help with.

items.speaker: Delegate
items.text: Through what?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Through Sonetto.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I have a meeting with her on Friday ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: This may lead us to a win-win situation.
TO BE CONTINUED…
